clue.text: Male hoists weapons

indicators.note: in a down light, hoisting lifts the word upward so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: a stag is a male deer, and the word is used for males generally

explanation.surface: A man lifting up guns, like a weightlifter with an arsenal.
explanation.definitionFit: Gat is American slang for a pistol, so the plural means handguns or weapons.

clue.text: It helps to make fantastic wine

indicators.note: the answer is a part that helps to make up the next word, so it lies inside it

explanation.definitionFit: Asti is a sparkling white Italian wine from Piedmont, named after its town.

clue.text: Sweet old tailless monkey

parts.note: douce is an old or Scots word for sweet or sedate

explanation.definitionFit: The douc is a brightly coloured leaf-eating primate of South-East Asia.

clue.text: Fury when game's up on time

stirred up, so these letters are mixed into a new order

clue.text: Purgative special soap smelt off

explanation.definitionFit: Epsom salts, magnesium sulphate, is a traditional laxative taken to clear the bowels.

clue.text: Devious old CIA spies on American stars

explanation.definitionFit: Cassiopeia is a northern constellation, a W-shaped group of bright stars.

clue.text: Re-knitted handy wool without special care

indicators.note: knitted again, so these letters are worked into a fresh arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A garment knitted again from convenient wool, carelessly.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something any old how means doing it carelessly or haphazardly.

clue.text: Snake's infection is eradicated

definitions.note: the definition is a snake; the 's stands for is, linking it to the wordplay

parts.note: sepsis is infection of the blood or tissues
taken as written

clue.text: Deskman scattered doubters around Italy

clue.text: Unbalanced by confinement czarist rule collapsed before end of century

clue.text: At first Ramsay used expletives. Pity

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of each following word

clue.text: Round spot left in hair cut

clue.text: Weight's satisfactory

a clipped informal form of okay, meaning all right

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an old Turkish weight, and a variant of okay meaning acceptable.

clue.text: Here maple's flourishing is short-lived

parts.note: taken as written
the word maple, its possessive ending giving no letter

clue.text: Feeling of waste after fine MP is sacked

dung is animal waste

clue.text: Wild rough girl is slim-waisted

clue.text: Processed game and deer making lots and lots of money

parts.note: taken as written

clue.text: Complete last of deals with hot money

clue.text: Scottish Premier League's drive to spend a lot

clue.text: Officer returned wearing pale-coloured blanket

clue.text: Things containing foul-smelling resin
